name: reference_v1
description: Strict sequential motion blueprint: a single repeating 4-beat camera cycle. Panel i uses segment (i mod 4) in order, so every cycle plays 1) Zoom In, 2) Pan Down, 3) Pan Up, 4) Zoom Out, then repeats continuously. Beat kinds are fixed by pan_kind_for_seg: static + zoom>=1.1 => zoom_in, dominant downward move => pan_down, dominant upward move => pan_up, static + zoom<=0.95 => zoom_out. Zoom travels are kept small so each push/pull reads slow and cinematic. Normalized template: the renderer adapts dx/dy/zoom to any panel/canvas size. Positive dy = downward, positive dx = rightward. Do not invent behavior beyond these four beats.
